name: Congenital Vertical Talus
definition: Rigid congenital flatfoot deformity with dorsal dislocation of the navicular on the talus, sometimes associated with neuromuscular or syndromic disease.

investigations.principle: Specialized radiographs in forced plantar flexion help confirm diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgery is often required after initial casting to maintain correction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada congenital deformity may be documented only in parallel with structural diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Rigid congenital flatfoot deformity with dorsal dislocation of the navicular on the talus, sometimes associated with neuromuscular or syndromic disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
